children: Science Applications International Corp reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $1.88B, up 6.3% from $1.77B a year earlier, while net income fell to $102M from $127M and diluted EPS declined to $2.38 from $2.71— 10-Q Summary.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth of about 6% was driven by volume ramp on existing and new contracts and contributions from the SilverEdge acquisition.
Approximately 97% of revenue came from the U.S. government, with Defense & Intelligence and Civilian segment contract ramps leading growth.
The company is advancing AI, cloud, cybersecurity and managed-service offerings through its STG business to support digital modernization demand.
Management reorganized into three customer-facing business groups to simplify structure and improve customer focus.
Total backlog was $22.1B with $1.2B of net bookings in the quarter, supporting near-term revenue visibility.
